conflict_rules: Server action registry: A1 adds web/supabase/functions/owner-provision-business/modules.ts. Each lane puts every new action in its own module file (access.ts and support.ts for A, lifecycle.ts for B, config.ts for C, ops.ts and n8n.ts for D). Each module exports {permissions, handlers, audited}. Joining the registry is a one line append in modules.ts. After A1, no lane adds entries to index.ts's handlers map, AUDITED map, or settings.ts PERMISSIONS. Until A1 merges, lanes B to D do SQL-only PRs.

index.ts in place edits are allowed only inside the owning lane's function ranges. A: auditLogList, adminsList/adminInvite/adminUpdate, the ticket functions, and the auth, MFA and permission block of the main handler. B: saveBusiness, the setup_save_* paths and finishSetup. C: overviewData, the industry functions, agentsList, integrationsOverview, plansList/planSave, and the brokenIntegrations lines of platformStatus. D: the rest of platformStatus and the platformSettingSave allowlist (append only, one line per key). Nobody edits dashboard_data, businessDetail, the suspend, cancel and undo functions (BIZ-03 PR), or processCancellations.

settings.ts: existing handlers are edited only by their owner (A: roles_save, security_overview, PERMISSION_CATALOG, tickets entries; B: onboarding_overview, privacy_overview). New actions never go into settings.ts.

Shared catalog: web/supabase/functions/_shared/catalog/ has one JSON file per lane (access, lifecycle, messaging, config, ops) plus a loader, so no two lanes edit the same file. Every PR that adds an audit action, alert kind or permission adds it to its own lane's file in the same PR. The drift test in npm run lint fails otherwise.

web/src/settings/AdminPanels.jsx: each lane edits only the panel functions it owns (A: SecurityOverview, RoleMatrix. B: Onboarding, Lifecycle, Provisioning, DataLifecycle. C: AgentRegistry, AiTesting, AgentConfiguration copy. D: OauthApps, Readiness, N8nConfig, AlertRules). Any new panel body goes into a new file in web/src/settings/panels/, so the AdminPanels.jsx diff is an import plus a one line render. All AdminPanels.jsx hunks rebase after the frontend polish PR (UI-27, UI-32, UI-33) merges.

Files held by other jobs are never edited: OwnerDashboard.jsx, ownerFormat.js (until the Businesses list job merges; then only A11), BusinessDetails.jsx, BusinessAdminControls.jsx, AutomationOverview.jsx, settings/VoicePanel.jsx, StatusPage.jsx, the cancellations files, and PlatformMonitoring.jsx (A10 starts only after the safe retry PR merges). No lane adds an admin menu entry or App.jsx route. New views live as tabs or sections inside pages the lane owns. App.jsx is also touched by the open claude/owner-onboarding-* branches.

Single file owners: CreateBusinessWizard.jsx belongs to B (B1). C8 edits it only after B1 merges. Both coordinate with the polish agent's UI-30. callOwnerFunction already passes error.code through, so ACC-19 doesn't edit it. MessagingPage.jsx and BusinessEmails.jsx belong to B. D may add only the one line checklist link. VoiceNumbersPage.jsx belongs to D. PlansPage.jsx belongs to C, after UI-12 merges.

SQL function ownership: a database function is replaced by one lane only. D: zella_admin_scheduler_health, zella_dispatch_n8n, zella_admin_voice_overview, zella_admin_voice_alerts, zella_platform_alert, zella_claim_admin_alert_email, zella_admin_business_automations_pause. If the guard fails because another PR landed first, rebase and recompute. Never edit an applied migration.

Each PR has its own new migration file with a matching sql/rollback/*_rollback.sql, tested with tests/lib/isolated_guard.sh against zprod3 only. Two PRs in the same lane that replace the same function are sequenced, and the later guard pins the earlier body.

owner_decisions.question: When should two step sign in for every admin go live in production (deploy the web app and owner-provision-business, then apply sql/zella_admin_mfa.sql)?

owner_decisions.question: Should creating a Zella Voice owner and changing an admin's role also need a second owner's approval, or only a fresh code?
owner_decisions.recommended: Only a fresh code (authenticator code entered within the last 5 minutes) for admin_invite, admin_update and roles_save. Add a second owner approval later if the owner team grows past two.

owner_decisions.question: Build the Growth page (prospects, demos, growth.manage) now, or mark REQ-ADM-18 as later?

owner_decisions.question: The repo has no CI. Should GitHub Actions be added to run the drift test and other tests on every PR?
owner_decisions.recommended: Run the drift test in npm run lint now. Add GitHub Actions as a separate owner approved change.

owner_decisions.question: May an agent run read only SELECTs in production on an allowlist of configuration tables to produce a committed reference fixture?
owner_decisions.recommended: Yes, if the export script has an explicit table and column allowlist, refuses any row with a business_id, never reads secrets or integration tables, and the diff is reviewed in the PR.

owner_decisions.question: Who may delete a never finished draft business?
owner_decisions.recommended: Zella Voice owner and super admin only, with the business name typed to confirm and a required reason.

owner_decisions.question: After how many days is an unfinished draft abandoned, and should Zella Voice ever delete one automatically?
owner_decisions.recommended: Flag drafts untouched for 30 days as 'Abandoned' on Settings, Business onboarding and alert once. Never delete automatically; a person uses Delete draft. Lane B builds this right after the answer.

owner_decisions.question: Who starts a whole business export and who receives it?
owner_decisions.recommended: An admin requests, a Zella Voice owner approves, and the file is downloadable from the admin page for 7 days through a signed link. Owner self service and emailed links come later.

owner_decisions.question: Which setup steps may be retried automatically?
owner_decisions.recommended: Only internal database steps (modules, automations, receptionist config). Owner invitation email, Vapi delivery and phone number steps get a manual 'Retry step' button only.

owner_decisions.question: Should businesses already live without documents be listed on Missing documents?
owner_decisions.recommended: Yes, in the same list labelled 'Live without documents'.

owner_decisions.question: Should switching an industry module off keep it for businesses that already use it?
owner_decisions.recommended: No. Keep today's behaviour (off for everyone, a kill switch), show 'N businesses will lose X' and require confirmation.

owner_decisions.question: Who may change an industry's sensitive flag, and what is a new industry's default?
owner_decisions.recommended: Zella Voice owner only, audited. A new industry starts sensitive, and turning it off asks for confirmation. The brain change (C9) needs approval even though the prompts stay byte identical.

owner_decisions.question: Should a failing AI evaluation block going live?
owner_decisions.recommended: Not yet. Show it as a warning on the go live checklist first.

owner_decisions.question: How should a platform wide receptionist wording change roll out?
owner_decisions.recommended: (a) A versioned platform base prompt used on every business's next call, with each business's own instructions kept separate, plus preview, an evaluation pass and one click rollback. Business sections stay owner approved.

owner_decisions.question: Threshold for the missed call alert?
owner_decisions.recommended: At least 5 inbound calls in 24 hours with 25% or more missed, severity warning, linked to that business's missed calls.

owner_decisions.question: Is template scope right: create only adds industry or language versions of existing platform keys, and retire only applies to overrides?
owner_decisions.recommended: Yes. A platform base template in use by a sender can't be retired.

owner_decisions.question: Are the contact lookup privacy defaults acceptable (business required, at least 4 digits or a full email, reason required, masked result, every lookup audited)?
owner_decisions.recommended: Yes, under comms.manage, with the last 4 digits only.

owner_decisions.question: Does posting an incident update notify business owners again?
owner_decisions.recommended: No by default. Updates are internal unless 'Show on status page' is ticked, and owners are notified only when 'Tell affected businesses' is ticked.

owner_decisions.question: What counts as '4 business hours' for support first response (REQ-BIL-47)?
owner_decisions.recommended: Monday to Friday 9:00 to 17:00 America/New_York, stored as a platform setting.

owner_decisions.question: Is this safety default right: urgent kinds can't be switched off or lowered, only rerouted, and quiet windows never delay urgent alerts?
owner_decisions.recommended: Yes. Warning and info kinds can change severity, destination, repeat interval and quiet hours.

owner_decisions.question: Which scheduled jobs should be on at go live, and should each be recorded now as 'deliberately off'?
owner_decisions.recommended: Record 'deliberately off until go live' for all of them now. zella_cron_cleanup can go on now. zella_dispatch and the every 5, every 15, hourly, daily and weekly jobs go on after the n8n workflows are deployed and the live switches reviewed. zella_platform_emails and zella_spam_hourly stay off until email_live and spam_workflow_live are approved. Each enablement is a separate owner action.

owner_decisions.question: When should billing emails that need only Zella Voice's own rows be scheduled?
owner_decisions.recommended: Right after CFG-14 ships, built into the platform_emails outbox and held in test mode until email_live. Not started until the owner says so.

owner_decisions.question: Are outbound webhooks for businesses (REQ-API-03) in scope for launch?
owner_decisions.recommended: No. Build only the inbound delivery log (read only over automation_events) and mark outbound webhooks and the public API as after launch in PRODUCT.md.

owner_decisions.question: Which platform reports run on a schedule, for whom, and how are they delivered?
owner_decisions.recommended: One weekly platform summary as an in app admin notification, plus the admin email digest once email is live, visible with a new reports.view permission. It depends on zella_jobs_weekly being on.

owner_decisions.question: Is the public API (REQ-API-01..04) in scope for launch?
